<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="טבת_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916230_theRebbe_919" batchId="meluket-_D7_98_D7_91_D7_AA_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916230_theRebbe_919__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section questions the order of the two interpretations in the maamar, noting that the first interpretation explains the word "haba'im" while the second does not.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Now, according to the known precision in the discourses of our Nesi'im, also in the order of the matters,</t>
    <t s="1">it must be understood:</t>
    <t s="2">the revelation of the root of the soul that will be in the future comes after and through the fulfillment of the mitzvos now,</t>
    <t s="3">and the order of the two matters</t>
    <t s="4">(interpretations)</t>
    <t s="5">in the maamar is,</t>
    <t s="6">that first comes the interpretation that "yashresh Yaakov" is the revelation of the root of the soul that will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="7">and afterwards comes the interpretation that "yashresh Yaakov" refers to the fulfillment of the mitzvos now.</t>
    <t s="8">Also, it must be understood,</t>
    <t s="9">that in the first interpretation</t>
    <t s="10">(that "yashresh Yaakov" refers to the redemption)</t>
    <t s="11">he explains</t>
    <t s="12">(also)</t>
    <t s="13">the word "haba'im,"</t>
    <t s="14">and in the second interpretation</t>
    <t s="15">(that "yashresh Yaakov" refers to the fulfillment of the mitzvos now)</t>
    <t s="16">there is no explanation of the word "haba'im."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains two aspects within the interpretation that "yashresh Yaakov" refers to mitzvah observance, citing the Alter Rebbe that mitzvos must be rooted in Israel, who are called "a desirable land."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, regarding the interpretation that "yashresh Yaakov" refers to the fulfillment of the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="2">there are two ways.</t>
    <t s="3">That the rooting of Yaakov is in the fulfillment of the mitzvos</t>
    <t s="4">(as above),</t>
    <t s="5">and that the rooting of the mitzvos is in Yaakov.</t>
    <t s="6">As the Alter Rebbe</t>
    <t s="7">(the Baal HaHillula of 24 Teves)</t>
    <t s="8">wrote in Torah Or, the discourse beginning "Zeh,"</t>
    <t s="9">that just as simple sowing must specifically be in the earth,</t>
    <t s="10">so too regarding the sowing of the mitzvos</t>
    <t s="11">(light</t>
    <t s="12">is sown for the righteous),</t>
    <t s="13">it must specifically be in Israel, of whom it is written,</t>
    <t s="14">"For you shall be</t>
    <t s="15">[to Me]</t>
    <t s="16">a desirable land."</t>
    <t s="17">And this is "yashresh Yaakov, yatzitz v'yifrach," etc.,</t>
    <t s="18">that "yashresh Yaakov" refers to the fulfillment of the mitzvos now,</t>
    <t s="19">that the mitzvos are sown and rooted in Yaakov,</t>
    <t s="20">and through this there will be in the future the growth,</t>
    <t s="21">"yatzitz v'yifrach."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that "haba'im" refers to the descent into exile, which prepares for the rooting of mitzvos, and that the final exile is preparation for the future revelation of the inner dimension of Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it explains in Torah Or there,</t>
    <t s="1">that the interpretation of "haba'im yashresh Yaakov" is,</t>
    <t s="2">that in order for there to be "yashresh Yaakov,"</t>
    <t s="3">the rooting of the fulfillment of mitzvos in Israel,</t>
    <t s="4">it is through "haba'im,"</t>
    <t s="5">the arrival into Egypt,</t>
    <t s="6">and as is known</t>
    <t s="7">that the Egyptian exile was a preparation for the receiving of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="8">And he continues there,</t>
    <t s="9">that just as the Egyptian exile was a preparation for the receiving of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="10">so too this final exile is a preparation to receive the inner dimension of the Torah that will be revealed in the future.</t>
    <t s="11">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="12">that this which he adds in Torah Or there, this matter</t>
    <t s="13">(that the final exile is a preparation to receive the inner dimension of the Torah that will be revealed in the future),</t>
    <t s="14">is,</t>
    <t s="15">because according to this, the connection of "haba'im" to "yashresh Yaakov" is sweetened,</t>
    <t s="16">that the implication of the verse is that the rooting is in the exile itself.</t>
    <t s="17">For regarding the Egyptian exile,</t>
    <t s="18">"haba'im" is only a preface to "yashresh Yaakov."</t>
    <t s="19">For through the Egyptian exile,</t>
    <t s="20">the iron crucible,</t>
    <t s="21">Israel were refined to be of the aspect of a desirable land,</t>
    <t s="22">and through this, their fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos after the exodus from Egypt and after the receiving of the Torah is in a manner of "yashresh Yaakov."</t>
    <t s="23">Therefore he adds that the final exile is a preparation for the revelation of the future,</t>
    <t s="24">that according to this,</t>
    <t s="25">"haba'im" also refers to the exiles after the Egyptian exile</t>
    <t s="26">up to and including this final exile,</t>
    <t s="27">for according to this interpretation,</t>
    <t s="28">"haba'im" and "yashresh Yaakov" are one matter.</t>
    <t s="29">That the rooting of the mitzvos in Israel</t>
    <t s="30">(through which there will be the growth in the future)</t>
    <t s="31">is primarily in the mitzvos that Israel fulfill during the time of exile.</t>
    <t s="32">As it is stated in Tanya,</t>
    <t s="33">that all the revelations of the future depend on our actions and service during the time of the duration of the exile.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
